How do you test an AI response when there’s no single “right answer”? 🤔

Traditional assertions can validate a button click or a status code. But when it comes to AI-generated responses, testing gets more nuanced.

That’s where LLM as a Judge comes in. It helps evaluate AI outputs for relevancy, faithfulness, hallucinations, bias, and more at scale.

But here’s the catch: How do you know if the judge itself is reliable?

In our latest blog, we explore how LLM-as-a-Judge works, the biases to watch out for, how to measure evaluation accuracy, and when to trust it in your AI testing strategy.
